nodes.description: Private mapping of holder address to token balance; credited and debited by transfer, transferFrom, _mint and _burn.
Nested mapping of owner to spender to approved allowance; mutated by approve, transferFrom, increaseAllowance and decreaseAllowance.
Total token supply, initialized to 500000000000000000000 (500 tokens) at construction and reduced by _burn.
Public tax rate constant (500 = 5%) used by findPercent to compute the per-transfer burn/tax amount.
Private token name string set in the ERC20Detailed constructor and exposed by name().
Private token symbol string set in the ERC20Detailed constructor and exposed by symbol().
Private token decimals value set in the ERC20Detailed constructor and exposed by decimals().
Constant string 'UniRocket' passed to the ERC20Detailed base constructor.
Constant string 'URCKT' passed to the ERC20Detailed base constructor.
Constant uint8 decimals value (18) passed to the ERC20Detailed base constructor.
Payable constructor that sets token metadata and mints the entire 500 token supply to msg.sender.
Internal mint helper; requires non-zero amount and adds it to the account balance.
Public view returning the current _totalSupply.
Public view returning the balance of an arbitrary address from _balances.
Public view returning the remaining allowance of a spender for an owner.
View helper computing value * basePercent / 10000, i.e. the 5% tax amount, using SafeMath.
Transfers 'value' from msg.sender to 'to', withholding a 5% tax that is credited to the hardcoded treasury address 0x78ba...3A3b.
Loops over receiver/amount arrays and performs a taxed transfer for each entry from the caller's balance.
Sets the caller's allowance for a spender without requiring the current allowance to be zero.
Transfers 'value' from 'from' to 'to' using the caller's allowance, deducting a 5% tax sent to the treasury address.
Atomically increases the caller's allowance for a spender.
Atomically decreases the caller's allowance for a spender.
External wrapper that burns 'amount' tokens from msg.sender via _burn.
Internal burn that reduces _totalSupply and the account balance, emitting a Transfer to address(0).
Burns tokens from another account using the caller's allowance and then calls _burn.
Caller-controlled address used for balance debits, allowance ownership and mint recipient.
Balance and tax arithmetic inside transfer: findPercent(value), value.sub(tokensToBurn) and chained balance add/sub operations.
Balance, allowance and tax arithmetic inside transferFrom: from balance sub, findPercent(value) and allowance sub(value).
Supply accounting subtraction in _burn: _totalSupply.sub(amount) and _balances[account].sub(amount).
Amount of tokens the caller wishes to transfer in transfer().
Recipient address of the transfer() call.
Array of recipient addresses processed by the multiTransfer loop.
Array of amounts paired with receivers in the multiTransfer loop.
Loop counter controlling how many internal transfer() calls multiTransfer performs.
Address being granted an allowance in approve().
Allowance value set for the spender in approve().
Source account whose balance and allowance are debited in transferFrom().
Destination account credited in transferFrom().
Amount moved and taxed in transferFrom().
Spender whose allowance is increased in increaseAllowance().
Amount added to the spender's allowance.
Spender whose allowance is decreased in decreaseAllowance().
Amount removed from the spender's allowance.
Account credited by the internal _mint helper.
Amount minted by _mint; equals the full supply when called from the constructor.
Amount burned from the caller by burn().
Account whose balance is destroyed by the internal _burn helper.
Amount removed from supply and balance in _burn.
Account burned from using the caller's allowance in burnFrom().
Amount burned in burnFrom().
Address whose token balance is queried in balanceOf().
Token owner queried in allowance().
Spender queried in allowance().
Value from which the 5% tax is derived in findPercent().

edges.reason: transfer() calls findPercent() to compute the 5% tax on the transferred value before moving balances.
transferFrom() calls findPercent() to compute the 5% tax on the transferred value.
findPercent() reads the basePercent state variable to derive the tax rate.
findPercent() consumes its value parameter to compute the tax.
transfer() writes the caller, recipient and treasury balances in _balances.
transfer() performs the tax and balance arithmetic grouped in the unsafe operation node.
transferFrom() reads and decrements the caller's allowance in _allowed.
transferFrom() debits the source balance and credits the recipient and treasury balances in _balances.
transferFrom() performs balance, allowance and tax arithmetic grouped in the unsafe operation node.
_burn() reduces _totalSupply by the burned amount.
_burn() executes the supply and balance subtractions grouped in the unsafe operation node.
burnFrom() delegates the actual supply and balance reduction to _burn().
burn() delegates the burn logic to _burn() with msg.sender as the account.
The constructor mints the initial supply through _mint().
_mint() credits the minted amount to the account balance in _balances.
multiTransfer() calls transfer() once per element of the receivers array.
The loop counter index determines how many times multiTransfer() invokes transfer().
msg.sender determines which balance is debited and who must own the transferred tokens in transfer().
msg.sender is the spender whose allowance is checked and consumed in transferFrom().
msg.sender is the allowance owner mutated by approve().
The constructor mints the whole supply to msg.sender, giving the deployer full control of balances.
msg.sender's allowance governs how many tokens burnFrom() may destroy from another account.
The value parameter drives the balance and tax computations of transfer().
The to parameter sets the credited recipient in transfer().
The receivers array supplies each recipient passed to transfer() inside the loop.
The amounts array supplies each value passed to transfer() inside the loop.
The spender parameter is the allowance key written by approve().
The value parameter is stored as the new allowance in approve().
The from parameter selects the balance and allowance debited in transferFrom().
The to parameter selects the credited recipient in transferFrom().
The value parameter drives the transferred and taxed amount in transferFrom().
The spender parameter is the allowance key increased by increaseAllowance().
The addedValue parameter is added to the spender's allowance.
The spender parameter is the allowance key decreased by decreaseAllowance().
The subtractedValue parameter is removed from the spender's allowance.
The account parameter is the credited address inside _mint().
The amount parameter is the minted quantity inside _mint().
The amount parameter is forwarded to _burn() by burn().
The account parameter names the balance destroyed by _burn().
The amount parameter is subtracted from supply and balance in _burn().
The account parameter is the allowance owner checked by burnFrom().
The amount parameter is the quantity burned by burnFrom().
The owner parameter is the lookup key of balanceOf().
The owner parameter is the outer mapping key in allowance().
The spender parameter is the inner mapping key in allowance().
The value parameter is the base amount on which the 5% tax is computed in findPercent().

normalization_plan.reason: The value parameter has no standalone semantics outside the balance and tax arithmetic of transfer().
The recipient parameter only identifies the credited _balances entry inside transfer().
The receivers array is consumed exclusively by the loop that calls transfer() in multiTransfer().
The amounts array is consumed exclusively by the loop that calls transfer() in multiTransfer().
The loop counter only governs the number of transfer() invocations inside multiTransfer().
The spender parameter is merely the _allowed key written by approve().
The value parameter is directly stored as the allowance in approve().
The from parameter only selects the balance and allowance entries debited by transferFrom().
The to parameter only selects the credited balance entry in transferFrom().
The value parameter drives the allowance consumption and tax arithmetic of transferFrom().
The spender parameter is only the _allowed key updated by increaseAllowance().
The addedValue parameter is directly added to the stored allowance.
The spender parameter is only the _allowed key updated by decreaseAllowance().
The subtractedValue parameter is directly removed from the stored allowance.
The account parameter is only the credited key inside _mint().
The amount parameter is only the credited quantity inside _mint().
The amount parameter is forwarded unchanged to _burn() by burn().
The account parameter is only the balance key destroyed by _burn().
The amount parameter is the operand of the supply and balance subtractions in _burn().
The account parameter is only the allowance owner checked by burnFrom().
The amount parameter is only the burned quantity in burnFrom().
The owner parameter is only the _balances lookup key in balanceOf().
The owner parameter is only the outer _allowed lookup key in allowance().
The spender parameter is only the inner _allowed lookup key in allowance().
The value parameter is only the base operand of the tax computation in findPercent().
